result.summary: The image depicts a high-speed, multi-lane arterial roadway that is hostile to pedestrians. There is a lack of marked crossings, pedestrian signals, and physical separation between the narrow sidewalk and the travel lanes.

hazards.name: High-speed multi-lane traffic
hazards.description: The wide roadway and lack of traffic calming encourage high vehicle speeds, increasing risk for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of protected crossings
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks or signals visible, forcing pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic unprotected.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with continental striping to improve visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon (HAWK)
interventions.description: Install a signalized crossing to stop traffic for pedestrians.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is highly hostile, characterized by a wide, multi-lane roadway with no physical separation between vehicles and the paved frontage. There is a complete absence of dedicated pedestrian infrastructure such as raised sidewalks, marked crosswalks, or safety signals.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Separation
hazards.description: The paved area in front of the building is flush with the high-speed roadway, offering no physical protection or curb to prevent vehicles from encroaching on the pedestrian space.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the building frontage

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide, multi-lane arterial lacks any marked crossings or pedestrian refuge islands, forcing pedestrians to cross a long distance unprotected.

interventions.title: Raised Sidewalk and Curb
interventions.description: Construct a standard raised sidewalk with a vertical curb to provide a dedicated and physically separated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with appropriate signage and potentially a pedestrian-activated signal to provide a safe crossing point.

interventions.title: Road Diet and Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the number or width of travel lanes to slow vehicle speeds and reduce the total crossing distance for pedestrians.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is extremely hostile, featuring a complete absence of sidewalks and marked crossings along a wide, multi-lane roadway. The adjacent commercial property has an undefined, continuous curb cut that allows for unpredictable vehicle movements across the area where pedestrians would naturally walk.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalks
hazards.description: There is no dedicated, separated walkway for pedestrians, forcing them to walk in the roadway or through an active parking/loading area.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the left side of the roadway in front of the commercial building

hazards.name: Excessive Curb Cut
hazards.description: The entire frontage of the commercial property is open to the road, creating a massive conflict zone where vehicles can enter or exit at any point.
hazards.location_in_image: The paved area between the roadway and the beer distributor building

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, paved sidewalk with a buffer from the roadway to provide a safe path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Management and Driveway Consolidation
interventions.description: Install curbing to define specific, narrow driveway entrances, reducing the area of conflict between vehicles and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Infrastructure
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks and consider a pedestrian refuge island to reduce exposure on this wide roadway.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is extremely hostile, characterized by a wide multi-lane arterial road with no sidewalks or marked crossings. Pedestrians are forced to use unpaved shoulders, and the lack of infrastructure suggests high vehicle speeds and significant crossing risks.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Facilities
hazards.description: Complete absence of sidewalks forces pedestrians to walk on unpaved grass shoulders or in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the roadway throughout the visible area.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane road lacks any marked crossings or refuge islands, making it dangerous to cross due to high exposure.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the entire width of the roadway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks on both sides of the road to provide a dedicated and safe space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island and Marked Crossing
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks and a raised pedestrian refuge island in the center median to reduce exposure and simplify the crossing task.
